text:
sam: Heads-up — planning a config-only rollout tonight in the quiet window 00:00-02:00 UTC. Changes: adjust routing weights (primary -> fallback), tighten batch_timeout from 30ms -> 20ms for short sequences, and reduce per-tenant concurrency limits for free tier. No model/version change. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~30m, manual hold between phases.

lina: Ack. Can you paste the exact diff you’ll apply?

sam: Yup — small snippet below:
```json
{"routing":{"weight_primary":0.55,"weight_fallback":0.45},"batching":{"batch_timeout_ms":20},"limits":{"free_tier":{"concurrency":2}}}
```

miguel: Rollback criteria? p99 token latency, error rates, or user-facing 5xx spikes?

carla: My suggested triggers: p99 token latency increase >15% vs baseline for 5m OR request error rate increase >0.3% absolute for 5m OR sustained 5xx count >=5/min in any region = rollback. Also fail if dedicated customer SLOs degrade.

sam: Plan to monitor p50/p95/p99, 5xx count, throttles, and cost rate. Rollback steps: 1) abort ongoing stage, 2) pin routing weights back to prior values, 3) run `deploy-bot rollback --thread 3785001234`, 4) follow incident chat (eng-oncall). I’ll be oncall for first hour.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary start at 00:15 UTC. will post status updates.

ops-runner: I’ll keep an eye on the batching queue depth and GPU utilization. Dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/route-batch (watch p99_token_latency, req_rate, 5xx).

jonah: FYI — don’t touch reserved pools for Dedicated customers (pool LZ-2). Add a guard so the routing change excludes LZ-2.

lina: Added guard in the patch: `exclude_pools: ["LZ-2"]`. Also updating release notes: "Config-only: routing weight re-balance and batch timeout reduction to improve tail latency/cost. No API or model changes."

sam: Good catch, @jonah — done. Canary schedule: 00:15 (5%), 00:30 (20%), 00:55 (50%), hold at 01:05 then final cutover target by 01:15 if healthy.

carla: I’ll act as rollback owner if we trip any of the thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 5% started at 00:15 UTC — health checks passing (first 10m).

ops-runner: can confirm GPU util steady, queue depth normal, p99 +2% so far.

miguel: Keeping runbook handy. If p99 breaches 15% I’ll trigger rollback.

sam: rolling forward to 20% now. pinging @lina @carla @miguel. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 20% at 00:30 UTC — quick health summary: p50 -1%, p95 +1%, p99 +3%, 5xx none.

carla: Looks healthy. continuing.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 50% at 00:55 UTC — metrics stable.

sam: holding at 01:05 per plan. no anomalies. preparing final cutover.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete to 100% at 01:12 UTC. Change recorded in releases: config-change/3785001234.

lina: Release notes published and tenant-facing doc updated.

sam: Thanks team — closing thread. If anything regresses, create an incident in incidents/ and ping eng-oncall.
